newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS NO REFINANCING REPO ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS NO REFINANCING REPO ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in a statement it would not hold any refinancing repo tenders on Wednesday.
The NBS also said it planned to drain some excess liquidity from the interbank market by selling treasury bills from its portfolio. The T-bills slated for sale will mature in 57 days.
Commercial banks' fulfillment of minimum reserves requirements is one of the NBS's main yardsticks for assessing money market liquidity.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector, as of August 12, exceeded by 2.21 percent the cumulative volume of funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements later this month.
The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns ($1.1 billion) in the current reserves period ending August 15.
